comments.author: abhipriya-gif
comments.body: ddgs is the duckduckgo-search tool and is listed as an optional requirement that only gets downloaded automatically if you install the smolagents[toolkit]. if you're using the core smolagents library it needs to be installed separately. that's probably why you're seeing this error. Installing it separately using `pip install ddgs` (if you use pip) should fix it

comments.author: valmetisrinivas
comments.body: @abhipriya-gif Thanks a lot. That helps. Hope the course creators/ administrators can incorporate the required change in the course/ notebook.

comments.author: albertvillanova
comments.body:
@valmetisrinivas in the course website, you can find the instructions on how to report a bug or suggest improvements to the course content: https://huggingface.co/learn/agents-course/unit0/introduction#contribute
> I found a bug, or I want to improve the course:
> - If you found a bug 🐛 in a notebook, please [open an issue](https://github.com/huggingface/agents-course/issues) and describe the problem

To install some tool-releated dependencies (besides the core `smolagents`), users need to install the `toolkit` extra:
```shell
pip install -U "smolagents[toolkit]"
```
